ideas.pitch: A single object detector built from random initialization that detects 40 base classes, flags unknown objects, and incrementally learns new classes without catastrophic forgetting.
ideas.problem_statement: Design and train one remote sensing detector that learns in two rounds, detects 40 known classes, flags unknowns, and incrementally learns new classes without pretrained weights.
ideas.title: AeroGuard-OWOD: Open-World Remote Sensing Detector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core technical requirements of Anveshak by solving catastrophic forgetting under zero pretrained weight constraints, which is the exact hard engineering challenge judges will evaluate.

ideas.pitch: An auxiliary energy-based outlier detection head coupled with a lightweight CNN trained from scratch to isolate unknown objects in overhead high-resolution tiles.
ideas.problem_statement: Imagery always contains unknown objects the taxonomy does not cover and requires flagging them rather than forcing them into known classes.
ideas.title: SatNovelty: Zero-Shot Unknown Object Flagging in Satellite Imagery
ideas.why_it_could_win: Judges will test edge cases with out-of-distribution objects; an explicit energy-bounded novelty scoring mechanism provides a mathematically sound solution for unknown classification.

ideas.pitch: A parameter-efficient architectural extension for scratch-trained detectors using exemplar memory buffers and prototype-based distillation to assimilate new classes rapidly.
ideas.problem_statement: New classes arrive gradually with only a few examples, and learning new categories can quietly degrade performance on old ones.
ideas.title: IncGeo-Prompt: Few-Shot Incremental Learning for Earth Observation
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the incremental few-shot adaptation constraint without relying on forbidden ImageNet or COCO backbone pre-training weights.

ideas.pitch: A web-based interface for visualizing real-time remote sensing detections, highlighting confidence scores for known classes, and flagging novel unknown objects on geospatial maps.
ideas.problem_statement: Design and train one remote sensing detector that learns in two rounds and keeps the same model throughout.
ideas.title: GeoWatch-Dashboard: Interactive Open-World Object Inspection UI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides a polished, demonstrable live UI that showcases model outputs clearly, a proven pattern from winning hackathon entries that helps non-technical judges grasp backend performance.

ideas.pitch: A memory-efficient episodic data storage and rehearsal pipeline designed to prevent catastrophic forgetting when training vision detectors from scratch on multi-round remote sensing data.
ideas.problem_statement: Learning new categories can quietly degrade performance on old ones while training entirely from random initialization with no pretrained weights.
ideas.title: Remotesense-Replay: Dynamic Replay Buffer Manager for Scratch Networks
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the specific data-management bottleneck of incremental learning under strict random initialization rules, demonstrating deep systems and algorithmic understanding.
